# freecsv2json.app

> Free, private, browser-based CSV to JSON and JSON to CSV converter. Bidirectional, RFC 4180 compliant, zero uploads.

## What it does
freecsv2json.app converts CSV to JSON and JSON back to CSV entirely in the user's browser. Paste data into the left pane; converted output appears live on the right. The parser follows RFC 4180 so quoted fields with embedded commas, escaped quotes, and multi-line values inside quotes all parse correctly — edge cases that break most free converters.

## Key facts
- 100% free, no sign-up required, no account
- Works offline (progressive web app with service worker)
- Privacy-first: zero tracking, no cookies, no analytics, no server-side processing
- Runs on any modern browser — desktop, tablet, or mobile
- Bidirectional: CSV → JSON and JSON → CSV with auto-detection
- Part of the Freesuite collection (freesuite.app)

## Features
- RFC 4180 compliant CSV parser (handles quoted fields, embedded delimiters, escaped quotes, multi-line values)
- Delimiter picker: comma, semicolon, tab, pipe, or any single custom character
- "First row is header" toggle (array of objects vs array of arrays)
- JSON output options: pretty or minified, array of objects or array of arrays
- CSV output options: quote only when needed or quote all fields, LF or CRLF line endings
- Copy to clipboard, download as .json or .csv, paste from clipboard
- Drop a .csv or .json file directly into the input pane
- Swap input ↔ output for round-tripping
- Live debounced conversion (150ms)
- Crash-recovery: last input saved to localStorage (capped 100KB)
- Dark mode, keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl/Cmd+Enter to force reconvert)

## Comparisons
- vs ConvertCSV.com: freecsv2json.app runs 100% in the browser with no uploads; ConvertCSV is server-side and processes files remotely.
- vs csvjson.io: both are browser-based; freecsv2json.app adds stronger RFC 4180 handling for quoted/multi-line fields, a live bidirectional workflow, and offline PWA support.
- vs Excel "Save as JSON": Excel has no native CSV-to-JSON export; freecsv2json.app fills that gap for non-technical Excel users.

## Related tools
- freejsonformatter.app — Validate and pretty-print JSON
- freesheets.app — Full spreadsheet editor in the browser
- freesqlformatter.app — Format and beautify SQL queries
